metric_definitions.equal_npu_slo: mean of per-NPU request SLO attainment across 128 NPUs
metric_definitions.target_statistics: mean, min, max, and spread across SSU 16/20/24

metrics.alpha1p5_equal_npu_attainment: mean over NPUs of the per-NPU fraction satisfying ttft_ms <= 1.5 * ideal_ttft_ms + 1e-12

preregistered_rule.scope: Conservative challenge of the theoretical alpha=1.5 default, not a claim of cross-seed or cross-interval global optimality.

two_qualified_challengers_tiebreakers: larger minimum per-SSU delta alpha1p5 attainment
if that difference is below 0.005, closer target ratio to the default
lower mean CIR path writes per second
